extension.description: Automatically track movies and TV shows you watch in Kodi on your WeTrakr profile. Marks content as watched, syncs your viewing activity in real-time.
extension.news:
v1.3.0 - Library sync with WeTrakr, both ways: watched (with dates), ratings and resume points of your Kodi library go to WeTrakr, and what you mark in WeTrakr (from any other app or device) is applied to the Kodi library. Manual marks in Kodi are sent instantly. Plan to Watch titles get the 'WeTrakr Watchlist' tag for widgets. Runs quietly in the background (never during playback) with a daily full pass; 'Sync now' and 'Reset sync state' in Settings > Library sync. - Movies played from video add-ons without ids are no longer lost: ids are read from the add-on's own plugin:// URL (Umbrella, Fen Light, POV...) and, failing that, the real file duration, original title and release date let WeTrakr match the title. Add-on streams resume where WeTrakr left off. - The User-Agent carries the installed add-on version.
v1.2.2 - Send the library scraper (TheTVDB or TMDB) and the episode air date with episode scrobbles, so WeTrakr can match shows that TheTVDB and TMDB number differently (e.g. The Great British Bake Off: season 17 on TheTVDB, season 10 on TMDB).
v1.2.1 - Fix video stutter when a notification appeared during playback. Notifications are now suppressed while a video plays; the "Scrobbled" confirmation is shown once at the end.
